findings.title: Trailing-slash export path yields empty resource name
findings.problem: A listed path such as 'report.csv/' passes _check_path (normpath strips the slash) and opens fine, but name = os.path.basename(given) is empty. The resource gets uri 'file:///', an empty filename, octet-stream mime, and the skip_names dedupe against server-returned resources is bypassed.
findings.impact: The user receives a nameless download for a file the model correctly named; duplicates of server-returned resources are not suppressed.
findings.recommendation: Derive the name from the normalized path: name = os.path.basename(p).
findings.check_notes: export.py:211 name = os.path.basename(p) from normalized path; test_trailing_slash_path_keeps_its_name covers uri and skip_names dedupe

fix.change: resource name derived from the normalized path (basename(p))

findings.title: Budget reservations leak on non-OSError in collect_exports
findings.problem: The loop catches only OSError. Any other exception after a file was reserved (ValueError from a NUL byte in a path via realpath/os.open, MemoryError in b64encode/join, pydantic ValidationError) releases only the current file's reserved_here; earlier files' bytes in out.reserved are lost with the discarded Collected. _export_call and _release_when_done also release nothing when the future raised.
findings.impact: Each occurrence permanently shrinks the pod-wide MAX_INFLIGHT_BYTES until restart, eventually refusing every export as 'busy'; a NUL-byte path also turns the whole call into a 500 after the tool already ran. Violates AC7 (reservation released in a finally).
findings.recommendation: Wrap the loop in try/except BaseException that calls release(out.reserved) and re-raises; refuse paths containing NUL in _check_path. Add tests for a NUL path after a good file and an injected mid-loop failure, asserting export._inflight == 0.
findings.check_notes: NUL refused in _check_path (170); collect_exports wraps _collect_into in except BaseException that releases out.reserved and re-raises (195-199); per-file finally still releases reserved_here, no double release; tests cover NUL after good file and MemoryError mid-loop with _inflight == 0

fix.change: NUL paths refused in _check_path; collect_exports releases out.reserved and re-raises on any exception

findings.title: No test for cancellation during export collection
findings.problem: The only path returning the reservation when the request is cancelled mid-collection is the _release_when_done done-callback in _export_call. No test cancels apply() while collect_exports runs; existing budget tests cover only send-completes, send-raises and construction-raises.
findings.impact: If the cancel branch or callback regresses (inverted exception check, wrong attribute), every client disconnect during export leaks pod-wide budget and later exports are refused as busy, with all tests still green.
findings.recommendation: Add an async test: monkeypatch export.collect_exports with a blocking function that calls export._reserve(n) and returns Collected(reserved=n); cancel the apply task mid-flight, let the thread finish, assert export._inflight == 0. Also assert _release_when_done is a no-op when the future raised or was cancelled.
findings.check_notes: test_budget_released_when_cancelled_during_collection and test_release_when_done_ignores_failed_or_cancelled_future added; cancel path in _export_call (shield + done-callback) matches test; autouse fixture resets _inflight

fix.change: tests only: cancellation mid-collection and _release_when_done no-op cases
